title: Lamb Kebabs with Mexican Flair
description: A fusion twist on traditional lamb kebabs, combining hearty flavors with the boldness of Mexican cuisine.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cumin, chili powder, and lime juice.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the lamb onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the lamb is cooking, mix together the syrup and garlic.
Brush the syrup mixture onto the lamb kebabs during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the lamb kebabs from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes.
Serve hot with your preferred sides.
